name: Combined DTI/MRI Volume Rendering
aliases: Combined MRI and DTI Volume Rendering
Interactive Volume Rendering of Diffusion Tensor Data
definition: A volume rendering approach that integrates visualization of conventional MRI and Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI) data to provide context-preserving visualization, specifically for surgical planning and understanding neural fiber connectivity in brain gyri.
summary: Combined DTI/MRI Volume Rendering integrates MRI structural context with DTI fiber data in a single pass, using RGB color maps and grayscale boundaries to aid surgical planning.
